_about: Map areas drawn as the game's own geometry (render/area.js). Built by build-map-areas.py, which carries the notes; the stage vertex normals come from mod-stage-normals.py. Vertex colour is a multiplier with 127 = 1.0, hence vcolScale.

areas.name: Forlorn Arena
areas.note: Raven's test case, 2026-09-24. Map 17 has only this area and its camp, and the whole area is ONE model: the sky shell, the cloud sea, the scenery rings, the mist banks and the arena floor are all primitives of m17a01d.mod, drawn at the origin. No placement .sdl.
